About

Curious by nature.
Rigorous by practice.

Nouman Ijaz is a cybersecurity student in Pakistan exploring the intersection of secure systems, artificial intelligence, and engineering research.

Approach

Research → Build → Evaluate → Document.

I care about work that can be inspected rather than merely described. That means clearly separating ideas, experiments, results, and limitations.

My current direction combines cybersecurity with AI/ML and deep learning—areas where careful evaluation and responsible implementation matter as much as technical ambition.
